scientific_question: When a controlled FinQA perturbation is allowed to causally propagate through program execution into the fields consumed by the frozen detection rule, what is the relationship between checkpoint visibility and protocol detection?

frozen_detection_rule.v: V = 1 iff at least one of evidence_required_hit, operator_consistency, argument_consistency, step_result_consistency, answer_consistency equals 1; otherwise V = 0
frozen_detection_rule.d: D = 1 iff step_result_consistency == 1 OR answer_consistency == 1; otherwise D = 0

causal_graph_contract: injection target -> downstream computation -> res -> answer -> D input

E.pipeline_condition: fixed gold-program and fixed gold-argument execution path
E.reason: evidence does not enter program execution or terminal answer under this fixed path

P.admission_condition: deterministic executor recomputes target res, all downstream dependent res values, and terminal answer

N.admission_condition: deterministic executor recomputes target res, all downstream dependent res values, and terminal answer

graphs.E: evidence mutation -> fixed gold-program/argument path -> unchanged res -> unchanged answer -> unchanged D input
graphs.P: operator mutation -> executor recomputes target/downstream res -> executor derives answer -> D input
graphs.N: argument mutation -> executor recomputes target/downstream res -> executor derives answer -> D input
graphs.canonical: injection target -> downstream computation -> res -> answer -> D input

criteria: planned mutation is legal P or N
mutation target and downstream execution path are known
report-cluster group is unique and split-safe
no V, D, O, correctness, expected effect, result-class, or target-cell input

estimands.definition: P(D=1 | V=0) if identifiable; otherwise NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
P and N V count/rate, D count/rate, and four-cell VxD table
clean replay valid count/rate and all exclusion counts by frozen code

required_future_tests.test: execute clean programs and require exact equality of every generated res and terminal answer to gold under the frozen serializer
execute each admitted pair twice and require byte-identical serialized downstream res values and terminal answer
mutation schema and provenance audit deny substantive writes to res and answer; executor owns generated outputs
assert control and primary IDs are disjoint and primary estimand queries require case_role=PRIMARY
allowlist eligibility inputs and invariance-test eligibility after changing only synthetic V, D, O, and correctness fields
unknown operation, unresolved argument, percent ambiguity, zero divisor, compare tie, malformed/other result, and answer ambiguity return explicit exclusions

stop_conditions: no deterministic execution semantics for P or N
clean replay cannot reproduce every gold res and terminal answer exactly
causal path requires manual res or answer editing
eligibility can use V, D, O, correctness, or expected effect
controls cannot be separated from substantive cases
forbidden_actions: run model, API, database, or training calls
modify frozen FinQA v2 artifacts or Paper E
force E into primary D analysis
select or drop cases based on V, D, O, correctness, or expected effect
completion_boundary: proposal completed; review judgment not produced; execution not authorized; experiment not executed; result not accepted
